_about.armor: the game's armour tables (mh3u_armor.py): helm 0xba6418, body 0xba87b8, arm 0xbaab88, waist 0xbacd90, leg 0xbaf058, 0x18-byte records read through 0x892ffc. `m`/`f` = the model each gender draws (record +2/+3, READ at 0x892a48); `wear` = record +6 (READ at 0x5dcb8c): m, f, b = Blademaster, g = Gunner. Names: the slot's message file at the record's index (Helm_eng.gmd ...), whose counts equal the table counts at 0xb02854; the message lookup itself is not traced. Records named DUMMY and the (None) record 0 are left out.
_about.inner: models drawn for an empty body / arm / leg slot, by the save's inner-wear byte (0x892a14 falls back to rodata 0xb06f78 / 0xb06f80 / 0xb06f88 = 60-63, indexed by player data +0x74, which 0x3d5b64 copies from the save). An empty helm or waist draws model 0.
_about.hairFace: per gender, per HELM MODEL (0-213): `hair[h]` = 14 masks, one per hair model, bit n set = hair part n drawn (0x24a9f8: a helm record +6 picks a row of the mask table 0xba59d0, 0 = the record's own u32); `face[h]` = face parts 0-6 drawn (record +5, 0x24a930); `hairClearsFace0[k]` = hair model k takes face part 0 away (its record +1). Male hair 13 clears the hair unit's flag 0x4000 instead (0x24aa14); that model is a 3-vertex stub.
_about.substituted: models 64, 200-206 and 208 are loaded as model 1 (0x8eef28); only DUMMY records use them.
_about.colors: the player's colours (notes/armor.md "Colours"). Each material carries a colour type (materials.json `ct` = .mrl record +0x18 bits 23-30; 0x199598 matches it) and the game writes the colour into that material's fMaterialStdAlbedoColor (0x567b54), which multiplies its albedo map: 1 hair (char +0x1c, the hair unit only), 2 skin (char +0x73e0, every unit but the hair), 3 armour pigment (per slot), 4 clothing (char +0x5768, every unit), 5 / 6 the face's Feature 1 / 2 (char +0x73e8 / +0x73ec; a colour whose top byte is 0 is Off and hides face part 5 / 6, 0x23f83c). `presets` = the 24 colour records at 0xb9b724, {R, G, B, x, y}: records 0-11 are the Hair Color choices (0x3dde28), 12-23 the Clothing Color and Feature choices (0x3ddee4, 0x3ddfa8); x, y is where each sits on the colour board td_color (`board`), and each is that board pixel. `skin.strip` = the Skin Tone choices: row 273 of GUI\Texture\startmenu\st_menu_01_eng.tex at x 0-189, the slider's range (0x3dc6a0 reads the texel; 0x3dc454 clamps to 0xbd); a new character starts at 189 (0x3db30c). `pigments` = the 44 armour pigment colours at 0xb028a0; armour row `pig` = the piece's own pigment (record +5, 0x895754) and `dye` = record +4 == 2, the pieces whose item can carry its own colour instead (0x894cd4 -> 0x893d90). A new character's hair, clothing and feature colours are not read.
_about.poses: the hunter's common motion lists (player\mot\plcom\mot_plcom_0000-0700), converted per gender onto the inner-wear body (build_armor_poses.py), played on that body as a proxy and copied to every piece by bone id. Bones 20-23 are each helm's and hair's own (their bind differs model to model) and follow their animated parent. The clips carry no names in the game data.
_about.models: v flipped and ETC1A4 alpha replicated as in the monster viewer (notes/decode.md 1-2); `hideIdx` = primitives whose mesh-table row lacks the draw bit (+0 bit 0), the proxy layer.
